title: orthochilus foliosus
intro: Orthochilus foliosus, commonly known as the 'Yellow Flag Orchid', is a species of orchid native to tropical Africa. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues, due to its several health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Orthochilus foliosus include its ability to reduce inflammation, alleviate pain, and modulate the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
